title: Follow the Question You Keep Asking
core_idea: Purpose may reveal itself less through a final answer and more through the questions you keep returning to over the years.
text: Is there a question that has followed you for most of your life? Maybe it's how people heal. Maybe it's why some things feel beautiful, or how to make a home feel safe. We tend to wait for purpose to arrive as an answer. But perhaps it shows up first as a question that won't leave you alone. You return to it in books, in conversations, in the work you drift toward without planning to. That steady curiosity may be pointing somewhere. You don't have to solve it today. Just notice which question keeps calling you back, and let yourself follow it a little further.
description: A gentle reflection on how the questions you keep returning to may quietly point toward your purpose.
